episode_summary: A Little Fish mailbag episode where Dan, Anna and Andy read listener-submitted curios about ants to the moon, place names, spy show coincidences, music in dog-food ads, tech and space oddities, and then ceremonially assign classic headline facts to new Clubfish patrons. Highlights include a computer forgetting to report the largest prime, a government misspelling in a press release, an angry training robot, and how many American meals are eaten in cars.

facts.fact: In 2015, the world discovered the largest prime number ever. It would have been discovered months earlier, but the computer which found it forgot to tell anybody.
In a press release about a new English language test for migrants, the British government misspelled the word language.
A New Zealand firm has developed an irrationally angry robot to train tele-sales staff.
It’s that a fifth of America’s meals are eaten in cars.
